subject: Payments Delay — Executive Summary
body:
Hi Raj,

Heads-up before the board call: Payments will slip from December 15 to approximately January 20, 2025.

Root cause: PCI-DSS Level 1 compliance gaps found by Kenji (email_02) require infrastructure changes and a mandatory third-party pen test (3-4 weeks). Secondary factor: the API rate limiter conflicts with Stripe webhooks (NEX-231, PR #47). We also underestimated compliance scope.

January 20 is achievable if the pen-test vendor is contracted this week.

Priya
